end.summary:
Discussed how litter and plastic can dirty beaches and pollute seawater.
Identified using bins, avoiding plant damage, and staying on paths as protective actions.
Practised why wild animals should not be fed and why coral should not be touched.
Feeding wild animals was still described as possibly helpful; this was not corrected after the last mention.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised ways visitors can protect fragile places, including using bins, staying on paths, avoiding plant damage, and observing animals from a distance. Tara explained clearly how plastic and wrappers can make beaches dirty and pollute seawater, and they connected staying on paths with protecting coral. Tara still mixed up whether feeding wild animals helps, and this was not corrected after the final mention. At home, ask Tara to sort actions into “protects” and “harms” for a beach, forest, or historic place, especially feeding animals and leaving food behind.
